session-goal.title: Native goal
session-goal.explanation: Manage the original Codex thread goal. Last observed goal state and action acknowledgment are separate. Clearing a goal does not confirm execution cleanup.
session-goal.unavailable: Native goals are unavailable for this session or the current original Worker.
session-goal.absent: The last native observation reported no goal.
session-goal.stale: The displayed observation may be outdated. Reload the saved state.
session-goal.invalidObjective: Enter a nonblank objective of at most 4,000 Unicode characters.
session-goal.invalidBudget: Enter a positive token budget no greater than 9223372036854775807.
session-goal.changed: The original session changed. Review the latest revision before saving.
session-goal.rebase: Use latest revision with this draft
session-goal.uncertain: Admission is uncertain. Retry only the same original request; this does not authorize another native send.
session-goal.recovery: The original goal action requires recovery. Reading goal state does not acknowledge or repeat that action.
session-goal.action.accepted: The original goal action was accepted and is waiting for native handling.
session-goal.action.claimed: The original goal action was claimed. Native acknowledgment is pending.
session-goal.action.acknowledged: The original goal action was acknowledged by the native thread.
session-goal.action.uncertain: The original goal action is uncertain. Do not send it again.
session-goal.readOnlyState: Native controls require the original running execution. Saved state remains readable after it stops or requires recovery.
session-goal.action.canceled: The original goal action was canceled before its native claim.
